title: Odd kernels exceed the dyadic coefficient-bit bill by at least 14
body:
## Summary
- On the ADDRESS coefficient-bit tariff, kernels `{3,5,7,9,15}` exceed the dyadic bill at every `j` from 0 through 32.
- That is 330 strict comparisons. The least fused margin is 14, at kernel 3 and `j = 0`.
- Partial receipt only. No new kappa, and no alternate tariff.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/odd-kernel-bit-margin/verify.py`
